name: Coverage

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  coverage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.8, 3.9, '3.10', '3.11']

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install pytest pytest-cov
        if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
        
    - name: Run tests with coverage
      run: |
        pytest --cov=src --cov-report=xml --cov-report=term-missing
        
    - name: Generate coverage badge
      run: |
        pip install coverage
        coverage xml
        python -c "
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
tree = ET.parse('coverage.xml')
root = tree.getroot()
coverage = root.attrib['line-rate']
percentage = float(coverage) * 100
color = 'brightgreen' if percentage >= 90 else 'yellow' if percentage >= 80 else 'orange' if percentage >= 70 else 'red'
print('coverage.svg')
with open('coverage.svg', 'w') as f:
  f.write('''<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"120\" height=\"20\">
  <rect width=\"120\" height=\"20\" fill=\"#555\" rx=\"3\"/>
  <rect x=\"60\" width=\"60\" height=\"20\" fill=\"'''+color+'''\" rx=\"3\"/>
  <text x=\"30\" y=\"14\" font-family=\"Verdana\" font-size=\"11\" fill=\"#fff\" text-anchor=\"middle\">coverage</text>
  <text x=\"90\" y=\"14\" font-family=\"Verdana\" font-size=\"11\" fill=\"#fff\" text-anchor=\"middle\">'''+f'{percentage:.1f}%'+'''</text>
</svg>''')
"
        
    - name: Commit coverage badge
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      run: |
        git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
        git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
        git add coverage.svg
        git commit -m "Update coverage badge" || echo "No changes to commit"
        
    - name: Push changes
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v0.8.0
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        branch: ${{ github.ref }}
